newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures mostly weaker in after-hours.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures mostly weaker in after-hours.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were mostly weaker in after-hours trade on Thursday, reflecting the yen's slight rebound against the dollar, traders said.
Prices ranged from unchanged to 0.4 yen per kg lower than the day's close. Benchmark March was down 0.4 yen at 134.3 yen.
Activity was slow, with only 4,598 lots traded.

During the day, prices edged lower as private investors were taking advantage of any price rebound to sell. "Expectations of a large delivery at the spot expiry later this month, reflecting rising rubber stocks, made investors wary of fresh buying," one trader said.
